title: Cause to Fight for
html:
Cause to Fight for

Quest Type

Side

Event

By Moon's Grace

Requirements

  • Complete Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism
  • Build "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim" at Moonlit Fair during the By Moon's Grace event.

Description

Jiyan sends a message from his post far on the frontline, which seems to concern something important...

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

Steps[]

  1. Head to "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"
  2. Talk to the elder
  3. Find the first soldier
  4. Find the second soldier
  5. Deliver the Lemongrass to Keni
  6. Find the third soldier
  7. Talk to Jiyan

Gameplay Notes[]

  • This quest is time limited.
  • Completing the quest unlocks Jiyan as a Lodge Wishes companion in the By Moon's Grace limited time event.

Dialogue[]

Quest Description
Jiyan sends a message from his post far on the frontline, which seems to concern something important...

Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.
(Talk to the elder)
Kind Old Man: Oh, it's you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Are you here for "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"?
Kind Old Man: What? Oh, not really… So this is the stall for that Gulpuff game? My apologies. My eyes aren't as sharp as they used to be.
Kind Old Man: My son is a Resonator. He might like this, I guess...
Your son?
Kind Old Man: Yes. He's a Midnight Ranger. They gave him a few day off. When he comes back, I plan to visit the Moonlit Fair with him.
Kind Old Man: Haha, I'm sure he'll have a lot of fun.
Jiyan (Contacting): (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), it's been a while.
Jiyan? Did something happen on the front lines?
Jiyan (Contacting): Don't worry. I'm not calling you for work this time.
Jiyan (Contacting): We have contained the hatching Threnodian. Any new threat from the Tacet Discords will likely take time to materialize.
Jiyan (Contacting): It wouldn't have been possible without you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Thank you.
Jiyan (Contacting): With the Moon-Chasing Festival near and our borders secured, I've granted leave for soldiers who haven't taken any in too long. They deserve time with loved ones.
Jiyan (Contacting): I will remain on post with the rest to ensure continued safety.
Jiyan (Contacting): That reminds me... Some of the soldiers on leave have lost their families to Tacet Discords.
Jiyan (Contacting): I'm not sure how they'll spend this time or if they need help. Maybe I will...
No need. You can count on me.
I'll go check on them for you.
Jiyan (Contacting): You... *smile* Then I'll gladly accept your help, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
(Head to the designated location)
Lele: Yanwu! You're back!
Jin: Yanwu! Where are the yummies you promised last time?
Yanwu: Oh no! I totally forgot…
Jin: Hmph! You liar!
Yanwu: ...Hahaha, just kidding! I got you some Loong Buns from the Moonlit Fair. Eat them while they're hot, they're the best that way!
Jin: Wow! Loong Buns! Thank you, Yanwu!
Lele: C-can I go to the Moonlit Fair too...?
Yanwu: Of course! Just let Auntie know and you can go!
Lele: Hooray!
Jin: Count me in! Come on, Lele! Let's go find Auntie!
The children run off with Loong Buns, playfully chasing each other.
Yanwu: Take it easy, kids! Watch your step!
Hello, Yanwu.
Yanwu: Oh hey, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! I remember seeing you during the last battle!
Yanwu: What brings you here? Thought you'd be at the Moonlit Fair.
Well, in fact…
You explain why you're here to Yanwu.
Yanwu: I see. General Jiyan was thoughtful to send you, but there's no need for that. I'm doing great. He worries too much.
Yanwu: I grew up in the orphanage nearby. Autie Director takes care of us like her own. The orphanage is my home now.
Yanwu: I'm not lonely at all. Look, my family's right here.
Those kids…
Yanwu: They're all orphans like me. Whenever I get leave, I stop by to catch up with them and chat with Auntie.
Yanwu: It gives me a sense of purpose, knowing I'm out there on the front lines fighting those monsters to protect them.
Need any help?
Yanwu: Help? Nah, nothing comes to mind. Maybe repainting the orphanage walls...
Yanwu: But nevermind, I can knock that out in an hour, tops!
Yanwu: Thanks for coming over to check on me, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)! It means a ton.
Yanwu: Alright, time for me to get cracking. See you around!
(Talk to the soldier)
Ke Ni: ...
...
Ke Ni: ...Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Are you visiting someone you know?
I am here for something else.
Ke Ni: I see... These graves hold fallen soldiers from before your arrival in Jinzhou. You probably don't know them.
...No, I don't know any of them.
Ke Ni: They're all soldiers who gave their lives in battles, protecting Jinzhou.
The name on the grave marker in front of Ke Ni catches your eye—that surname is the same as hers.
This is…
Ke Ni: It's my brother's grave. He served in the Rearguard. During a transport mission, his team... ran into an ambush.
Ke Ni: They fulfilled their duty, forming a human barricade to protect the carts from those monsters.
Ke Ni: By the time reinforcements came... it was too late. None of them survived.
They were heroes.
Ke Ni: Thank you. I'm sure he'd be happy to hear that from Jinzhou's savior.
Ke Ni: By the way... What brought you here today?
You explain why you're here to Ke Ni.
Ke Ni: Ah, I see. That does sound like something General Jiyan would say. Thanks for offering to help. Hmm, let me think...
Ke Ni: If you don't mind, could you fetch some Lemongrass for me? My brother loved its scent, despite not being a fan of flowers.
No problem.
Ke Ni: Thank you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
(Deliver the Lemongrass to Ke Ni)
Ke Ni: Thank you... It smells refreshing as always.
Ke Ni: It reminds me of when mom was alive... She always used Lemongrass in her fish soup. It wasn't the best, to be honest.
Ke Ni: The lemon grass and fish created a weird taste that I couldn't quite put my finger on.
Ke Ni: But she insisted it would make us taller. I couldn't handle it, so I'd pour mine into my brother's bowl. Well, he did grow really tall…
Ke Ni: I guess he loved Lemongrass because it reminded him of simpler, happier times...
Ke Ni: ...
Ke Ni: Sorry, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). I got carried away talking about my family... Haha, now I'm starting to miss my mom's fish soup.
Ke Ni: Alright!
Ke Ni: Since you brought me so much Lemongrass, I'll make that fish soup during my leave!
Ke Ni: It'll probably taste worse since I'm eating alone though. Oh well...
(Talk to the soldier)
Ningwei: You here for some sight-seeing too, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)?
Ningwei: Well, I know you're not. Ain't nobody got as much free time as me during days like this.
Your face... Are you injured?
Ningwei: Oh, no worries. Just a scratch from a few days back. It's all patched up now.
You don't seem to be enjoying your leave.
Ningwei: The leave... If I was a rookie, I'd be over the moon.
Ningwei: Think about it. Leave's all about food and friends and family reunions for most people, I bet.
Yeah, that's what everyone does.
Ningwei: Haha, EVERYONE…
You can go do all of that too.
Ningwei: I can, you say... Huh.
Ningwei: My village got swallowed up by the Waveworn, sunk right into the ground.
Ningwei: Like a stone skippin' on water, a few ripples and poof, gone for good.
Ningwei: Friends, family, everything I ever loved... vanished in a blink.
Ningwei: Had no idea what to do, but I wanted to live.
Ningwei: Then along came Jiyan.
Ningwei: Haha, you know what that fool... ahem, I mean General Jiyan did? He tried to recruit me! Asked if I wanted to help combat the Tacet Discords. Funny, isn't it?
Ningwei: As if that'll make a difference... Tacet Discords and the Waveworn stuff, those are natural disasters. They just happen. What can I even do about it?
Ningwei: But I said yes anyway. He made it sound real good. Figured dying on the battlefield beats starving in the wild.
Ningwei: Alright, you've heard it all. You should know my answer now.
Ningwei: How do I know what you're gonna ask? Well, Jiyan's been asking us the same darn question every leave!
Ningwei: And my answer stays the same—thanks but no thanks! I'm good being alone. As long as there's still Tacet Discords to fight. Keeps my fists busy.
I will tell him that.
Ningwei: Sure, now go. Oh, and take this with you.
Ningwei: Jiyan never seems to stop working. He keeps skipping meals once he gets busy.
Ningwei: Me and the boys made this stew with what we've gathered. He can have some.
It smells good…
Ningwei: Hey, no sneakin' bites! Well, maybe a nibble, but leave some for Jiyan, okay?
(Talk to Jiyan)
Jiyan: Tacet Discord remains contained to Norfall Barren. We should consider pushing our outpost positions further north.
Jiyan: Deploy new observation posts on the outskirts. This will give us early warnings and time to ready for future outbreaks.
Messenger: Roger that!
The messenger salutes and hurries away.
Jiyan: (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), what brings you here? Aren't you supposed to be in Taoyuan Vale?
Came back from one of the soldiers you mentioned. Wanted to check on you too.
Jiyan: I see. It's got to be Ningwei and his crew.
Jiyan: I told them to make the most of their leave... But they won't stray far from camp, even after years on the front lines.
Because they already consider it home.
I can understand why now.
Jiyan: Ah... They must have told you a lot, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
They have a gift for you too.
Jiyan: A gift? Could it be...
You set the bowl of stew in front of Jiyan.
Jiyan: Ha, knew it. Ningwei made it, right?
Jiyan: He probably mentioned how I recruited him, but I bet he didn't tell you the whole story.
Go on.
I love stories. Tell me more.
Jiyan: I wasn't the general back then. Just another medic on duty, returning to base after dark.
Jiyan: Made a stew for myself with whatever I had. That's when I saw Ningwei wandering alone in the wilderness.
Jiyan: He lost everything in a Waveworn disaster. He was all alone, didn't know what to do.
Jiyan: I shared my stew and listened as he talked about his struggles. About what happened after his hometown was gone.
Jiyan: His eyes were filled with hopelessness. He wanted to live, but couldn't find a reason to go on.
Jiyan: You already know what happened next. I asked if he'd want to enlist in the army. He said yes.
Jiyan: After that, Ningwei often makes stews to share with me during his leaves. Maybe to repay me for the stew from that night.
Jiyan: ...Nevermind, he's probably just showing off his cooking skills. Mine are lacking, to say the least.
Nice story. Your stew is getting cold, though.
Jiyan: ...Ah, thanks for the reminder.
Jiyan: Shall we eat together, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)? You must be hungry, having walked all the way here.
A little bit…
Don't mind if I do!
(Quest Complete)
